```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)

```


```{r}
#Reading in patient data
adjing.data <- openxlsx::loadWorkbook("T:/Labs/Spakowicz/mitox/Clinical info/Patient Data 7-1-22.xlsm")


#selecting sheet with progressed/treatment completed
Adj_Datasheet <- readWorkbook(adjing.data, sheet = "Adj Datasheet", startRow = 2)

alting_names <- rename(Adj_Datasheet, Coded.Sample = 52, Drugs = 21, Date.of.treatment = 22)

new_status <- subset(alting_names, Cohort != "Excluded")

#creating data frames with only sample and progression
status <- new_status %>%
  select(`Coded.Sample.#`, `Reason.for.discontinuation`, Cohort)

#adjusting names to match
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\) *", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\)*", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <-gsub("- ", "-", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
status$`Coded.Sample.#` <-gsub("^\\s+|\\s+$", "", status$`Coded.Sample.#`)
temp_status <- status %>% rename(Sample = `Coded.Sample.#`)
#removing samples that aren't in nanostring
load(file = "../Outputs/pt.char")
status_cohort <- subset(temp_status, (Sample %in% pt.char$Sample)) 


```

```{r}

   #removing extra information and correcting spelling
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( " */*Intolerance", "",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( " */ *", "",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\) *", "",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\)*", "",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <-gsub("- ", "-",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
   status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <-gsub("Toxcity", "Toxicity",  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
  
  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( " *\\(.*?\\) *", "", status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)
  status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation <- gsub( "^\\s+|\\s+$", "", status_cohort$Reason.for.discontinuation)

pt.status <- (status_cohort)
c.status <- merge(status_cohort, pt.char)  
g.c.status.t1 <- g.c.status %>% select(-Sample)
  
save(pt.status, file = "../Outputs/pt.status")

```
